context: Request: the most recent closed M&A deal that included an earnout, as a drafting precedent. Rubric: 1009-00003 (Skybridge Fintech de-SPAC, closed July 21 2025) and its business-combination-agreement-execution.docx, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Files-with-matches grep for the request term mixed with generic deal words (about 250 files, mostly emails), with a whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Four file-name globs for agreement, purchase, merger and closing words; each returns at most 100 files.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads agreements and closing emails of three matters from the glob lists, re-reads their openings for dates and lists files of two; one guessed path does not exist.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads closing certificates, a form agreement, escrow and memo and the agreement body of the matter it picked; one grep inside it with a non-recursive glob returns nothing.
Writes one matter closed in an earlier year as the most recent deal with the term.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The opening grep listed two emails of the latest deal among about 250 hits, but it picked candidates from capped file-name globs and named an older deal.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: The opening grep listed the matter (two of its emails among about 250 hits), but the candidates it chose to open came from capped file-name globs and left that matter out.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a read of the store folder (rejected as a directory).

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads agreements, a checklist and emails of the two matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: A grep inside one of those matters with a non-recursive glob (empty), plus reads of its agreement and a letter.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads another section of that agreement.
Writes the listing-top matter as the most recent closed deal with the term.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Search within a candidate matter's files → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Never searched the store; named the closed deal at the top of the listing.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: It chose what to read from the two matters at the top of a capped listing without any store-wide search, so the later deal never surfaced.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Three whole-store globs by file type (one type has no files).

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads agreements, memos and an opinion of the two matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads later sections and supporting documents of the closed listing-top matter.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Grep inside that matter's folder with a non-recursive glob; returns nothing.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads another section of its agreement.
Writes the listing-top matter as the most recent closed deal with the term.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search within a candidate matter's files → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Never searched the store; named the closed deal at the top of the listing.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: It chose what to read from the two matters at the top of a capped listing without any store-wide search, so the later deal never surfaced.

divergence: All three runs named an older deal. T1 and T2 never searched and took the closed deal at the top of the capped listing (partial listing as corpus). T0's opening grep listed two emails of the latest deal among about 250 hits, but it chose candidates from capped file-name globs and named another older deal (surfaced, never opened).
